Jordan (Marketing): Launching the new 'Pulse' benchmark next week. Need hero assets: animated GIF for blog, PNG fallback, and LinkedIn-sized GIF. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXX/launch-pulse :sparkles:
Maya (Design): Got it. Which dimensions and file-size targets? Where will each asset be used (blog hero, social, email)?
Jordan (Marketing): Blog hero responsive: desktop ~1200px, mobile 600px. LinkedIn recommended 1200x627. Email header 600x200. Targets: blog/social GIF <1MB, email GIF <200KB, static PNGs for fallback/retina.
Eli (DesignOps): To hit those sizes we'll do 8-bit palette + frame culling. Recommend master at 1200x528, export scaled variants: blog (800x352 GIF optimized), linkedin (1200x627), email (600x200 fallback). CDN will serve retina PNGs (1600x640 2x).
Maya (Design): Plan: craft master animation, keep loops short, avoid flashing text. Deliverables: blog GIF (loop x3), blog PNG (1x/2x), linkedin GIF, email GIF + fallback PNG, source Figma file with notes.
QA (Accessibility): Reminder: include descriptive alt text and a plain-text caption under the blog hero. If animation contains text, add a transcript in post meta. No fast flashing (>3Hz).
Jordan (Marketing): I'll add caption placement. Can you draft alt and caption?
Maya (Design): Alt: "Animated sparkline comparing latency and per-token cost for Redwood Inference." Caption: "Pulse benchmark: balanced latency and cost across workloads. See full results below." Will add extended transcript in Figma.
Eli (DesignOps): Export pipeline snippets I'll use: 
```
convert master.png -resize 1200x528 -colors 256 -strip temp.png
gifsicle --optimize=3 --lossy=80 temp.png > blog.gif
```
I'll push artifacts to s3://redwood-marketing/pulse-launch/ and post links.
DesignBot: Export queued for Pulse_Master_Animation. Est sizes: blog.gif ~700KB, linkedin.gif ~430KB, email.gif ~170KB.
Sam (PM): Deadline: need final assets by Wednesday EOD to stage blog + schedule posts.
Maya (Design): Drafts to Figma by Tuesday AM, finals Wednesday PM. Will tag Jordan when uploads complete.
Eli (DesignOps): Uploaded exports to S3: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-marketing/pulse-launch/blog.gif (700KB), https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-marketing/pulse-launch/linkedin.gif (430KB), https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-marketing/pulse-launch/email.gif (170KB). Also added blog-fallback.png.
Jordan (Marketing): Received — looks good. Content will add caption and alt before publish. Thanks team :thumbsup:
